name: r033.phase4_semantic_autonomous_sound_return_rev1_mcw
description: R-033 semantic-only successor: an idle structural camp must autonomously dispatch, reach an abstract watch before a delayed fixture C-4 emits, consume the native sound, and later publish a matching returned_report lead.  The native run proves the route; fixture staging is zero-credit and no legacy GUI/debug transport is used.

steps.label: audit_idle_structural_source_footing
steps.abort_reason: the fresh semantic route lacks its sole non-signal road opportunity or idle roster

steps.label: audit_delayed_zero_credit_c4_source
steps.abort_reason: the isolated source item or its exact post-watch native timer is missing, or a competing field channel is authored

steps.label: operate_r033_autonomous_sound_return
steps.objective: Bind pre-input idle roster, road lead, source countdown, source/executable, and HUD frame. Use only observed native semantic waits to separately establish autonomous dispatch, abstract watch arrival before source emission, run-bound production sound/callback, and a later source-matched returned_report lead. The source is the route's persisted first forward OMT and its exact timer is one minute after watch. Stop on the first contradiction. Do not replay F001 or use GUI/debug transport.
proof_targets: idle roster and sole non-signal lead before input
native dispatch and exact abstract watcher ownership
run-bound native sound record and callback
authority: game.raw_wait with bounds derived from observed game minutes
invariants: the source may not count before native watch arrival
no injected signal, lead, report, operation, member, route, or owner
F001 is not replayed or repaired
returned_report must match this run's source provenance

proof_gates.label: R-033 autonomous abstract sound-return route is bound to one native session

evidence_contract.claim: one current-source semantic-only run may establish native abstract dispatch/watch, later native sound, and its matching returned_report lead; it does not establish dedup or aging
evidence_contract.failure_rule: a pre-watch source fact, missing native owner/source/callback/return binding, or any extra owner/state mutation leaves the route unproved
